{"batchcomplete":true,"query":{"pages":[{"pageid":5494,"ns":0,"title":"Regeneration","revisions":[{"revid":1141317,"parentid":1101597,"timestamp":"2025-11-09T15:51:57Z","sha1":"8c039e96cd89cbcf35e0e64ad578ae6f218771e4","slots":{"main":{"contentmodel":"wikitext","contentformat":"text/x-wiki","content":"{{outdated}} ==Overview== All players automatically regenerate [[Mana]] and [[Hitpoint]]s over time as long has they have eaten some kind of [[Food]] recently. All food regenerates mana and hitpoints for some length of time depending on the food. The longest you can regenerate for without consuming more [[Food]] is 1200 seconds (20 minutes). See the [[Food]] page for more information on the different kinds of edible items. ==Regeneration Rates== All vocations regenerate mana and hitpoints at different rates. Knights regenerate [[Hitpoint]]s the fastest, while [[Druid]]s and [[Sorcerer]]s regenerate [[Mana]] the fastest. The kind of food eaten does not affect the regeneration rate. If a player has purchased a [[promotion]], then they will regenerate [[Mana]] and/or [[Hitpoint]]s faster. A character's regeneration rate will double while inside a [[Resting Area]] if he/she has a streak of 5 (health) and 6 (mana) or more consecutive days picking up [[Daily Reward System|daily rewards]]. This bonus also affects all regenerative items, meaning their efficiency will be twice the numbers displayed on the related pages. For more information on regeneration rates, see pages specific to each vocation:

==Special Items== Eating food is not the only way to regenerate [[Hitpoint]]s and [[Mana]]. There are some special items that can be used. These items will instantly replenish [[Mana]]: * [[Mana Fluid]]: replenishes 100 mana on average * [[Mana Potion]], [[Strong Mana Potion]], [[Great Mana Potion]], [[Ultimate Mana Potion]], [[Great Spirit Potion]], [[Ultimate Spirit Potion]]: replenishes 100/150/200/500 and 150/200 mana on average, respectively. The smaller the potion is, the [[Money Spent per Mana Point|more profitable MP/GP]] it becomes. * [[Blessed Steak]] instantly fills all your mana. These items will quickly replenish [[Hitpoint]]s: * [[Life Fluid]]: replenishes a small amount of hitpoints * [[Small Health Potion]], [[Health Potion]], [[Strong Health Potion]], [[Great Health Potion]], [[Ultimate Health Potion]], [[Supreme Health Potion]], [[Great Spirit Potion]], [[Ultimate Spirit Potion]]: replenishes 75/150/300/500/750/1000 and 300/500 hitpoints on average, respectively. ''The smaller the potion is, the [[Money Spent per Hit Point|more profitable HP/GP]] it becomes.'' * Healing Runes ([[Intense Healing Rune]], [[Ultimate Healing Rune]]) replenishes hitpoints based on the user's level and magic level. ''Intense Healing Rune is more profitable than Ultimate Healing Rune.'' * Healing Spells ([[Bruise Bane]], [[Light Healing]], [[Intense Healing]], [[Ultimate Healing]], [[Divine Healing]], [[Heal Friend]], [[Mass Healing]], [[Wound Cleansing]]) replenishes hitpoints based on the caster's level and magic level. ''The less mana a spell uses, the more profitable HP/MP it is.'' * [[Pot of Blackjack]] heals 5,000 hitpoints. * [[Rotworm Stew]] instantly fills all your hitpoints. === Regenerative Amulets ===
